answer: Coordination fee charge makes every identity joining a multi-agent action pay a nonrefundable fee set by current contention. The coordinator checks each request against a basalt-anchored log and rejects duplicates unless the full fee is paid again. A rejected credential leaves a relic that must be cleared by a separate verification step. Settlement in copper means 1,000 sybils cost 1,000 fees plus 1,000 verifications before any coordination occurs.
